nodes.label: Wait for the user to confirm
nodes.text: Wait for the user to confirm before proceeding. If they say "analyze only", switch to Mode 2.

nodes.label: the scanner exits non-zero, stop and
nodes.text: If the scanner exits non-zero, stop and ask a human to review its file/line findings. Do not silently rewrite the generated files, and do not load or publish the skill until the findings are resolved or explicitly accepted.

nodes.label: Never copy raw book text —
nodes.text: Never copy raw book text — always synthesize, summarize, extract signal

nodes.label: Action: Run Steps 0–3, then produce
nodes.text: Action: Run Steps 0–3, then produce a structured extraction report (frameworks, principles, techniques found). Stop — do NOT generate skill files.

nodes.label: Trigger: User has existing analysis notes
nodes.text: Trigger: User has existing analysis notes or previously ran analyze-only

nodes.label: For generated book skills, pick a
nodes.text: For generated book skills, pick a destination that the user's host agent can actually discover (see Step 5). When more than one valid root exists, ask the user once and remember the answer for the session — do not silently default.
